item_decisions.quote: Pfizer Inc. (“Pfizer” or the “Company”) completed the previously announced acquisition of Metsera, Inc., a Delaware corporation (“Metsera”), pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger
completed a public offering of €750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 2.875% Notes due 2029
Pfizer Inc. (the “Company”) completed a public offering of $500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of Floating Rate Notes due 2027
